hints.title: Row Reduction Process
hints.text: Each step replaces an array of length m with an array of length m - 1 where new[i] = (nums[i] + nums[i + 1]) % 10.

hints.title: Termination Condition
hints.text: Repeat this reduction until the array length is 1, then return its single remaining element.

hints.title: In-Place Modification
hints.text: Since n <= 1000, simulating row by row in-place requires O(n^2) operations and O(1) extra space.

hints.title: In-Place Row Simulation

variables: n: length of nums array (up to 1000)
complexity.notes: Sum of i from 1 to n is n*(n-1)/2 operations, running well under 10^6 steps.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Creating new arrays at each step consumes O(n^2) memory allocations.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Reusing the input array runs in O(1) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate writes clean in-place simulation or discusses Pascal triangle coefficients modulo 10.
